title: E3 Reading – Set L Exam Practice – Lesson Audio

scripts.label: Script A – Using a Public Library (Hangman Paragraphs)
lines: A public library is a useful place for new learners of English. Anyone can join for free. You can borrow books, read newspapers and use a computer. Many libraries have a quiet room where students can study. If you cannot find the book you want, a librarian will help you. It is a warm, friendly place to practise your reading.
questions: “If you cannot find the book you want, a librarian will help you.” Who helps? (A librarian)
“It is a warm, friendly place to practise your reading.” What is “It”? (A public library)
“Anyone can join for free.” What does “for free” mean? (It costs no money)
